DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は一人お休みですね。台詞はどうしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: One person is absent today. What shall we do about their lines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本人から欠席の連絡が来ました。理由は詳しく言わず、台詞だけ分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 欠席理由を伏せ台詞分担を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: They let me know they would be absent. I would like to divide up just their lines without going into the reason.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Keep the reason for the absence private and suggest dividing up the lines. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこから担当できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前半は私が読みます。後半は友人に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前半を引受け後半の担当確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will read the first half. Could you check with my friend about taking the second half?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Take the first half and ask someone to confirm who will read the second half. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人も後半なら読めるそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your friend says they can read the second half.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、台本の境目に印を付けて、重複して読まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 分担境界を台本へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will mark the dividing point in the script so we do not read the same lines twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mark the boundary between the assigned parts in the script. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の役名は残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave the original character names in place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 役名は消さず、今日読む人の名前を横に小さく書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 役名と当日担当名を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave the character names and write today's readers' names in small letters beside them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the character names from the names of today's readers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次回、その人が戻ったらどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: What will you do when that person returns next time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日だけの代役なので、次回は本人に返して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一時的代役として次回戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is only a stand-in arrangement for today, so next time I will give the part back to them and confirm it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Make this a temporary substitution and return the part next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、本日の分担で読み合わせを始めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us begin the read-through with today's assignments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご用件でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内の荷物配送を頼みたいです。駅で受け取った紙です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅配布の案内にある配送の申込みを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to arrange the baggage delivery advertised on this leaflet. I received it at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to book the delivery service advertised on a leaflet distributed at the station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙に書かれている運営会社はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the name of the company operating the service, as printed on the leaflet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鉄道ではなく、別の配送会社の名前ですね。配られた場所しか見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運営会社を読み配布場所と運営主体の違いを認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the name of a separate delivery company, not the railway. I had only looked at where it was handed out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the operator's name and acknowledge the difference between the distribution location and the service operator. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらではその会社の手続きはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot process that company's requests here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅のサービスだと勘違いしました。紙にある問い合わせ先へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鉄道窓口では扱えないと理解し会社へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I mistakenly thought it was a station service. I will contact the inquiry number on the leaflet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the railway counter cannot handle this and contact the company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 料金や取扱いも、そちらへご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the fees and service details with them as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を窓口に置いて頼むことはしません。自分で持って移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を鉄道窓口へ預けず自分で持つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not leave my bags at this counter and ask you to deal with them. I will carry them myself as I move on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep your luggage with you rather than leaving it at the railway counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅構内の通行を妨げないようお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take care not to obstruct people passing through the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙と荷物をまとめます。列を空けて、落ち着いて連絡先を読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列を空け案内の問い合わせ先を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will gather the leaflet and my luggage. I will step out of the queue and calmly reread the contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Step out of the queue and reread the inquiry details on the leaflet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ご確認ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please check them. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 氏名欄についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the name field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場で呼ばれる短い名前を書きました。持ってきた証明書とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 略した日常名と証明書氏名の差を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the short name people call me at work. It differs from the name on the identification document I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between your abbreviated everyday name and the name on your identification document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの手続きの申請書でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which procedure is this application form for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この証明書の申請です。名前を省略しても分かると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申請の種類と省略した理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is an application for this certificate. I thought you would recognize my name even if I shortened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the type of application and why you abbreviated your name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この申請で必要な表記を、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check with the person in charge which form of your name this application requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で書き直す前に確認します。証明書の長い名前をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 訂正前に担当確認を求め正式表記を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check before rewriting it myself. I will show you my full, long name on the identification document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the person in charge to check before making corrections and show the official spelling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 普段の呼び名と証明書の表記を分けてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain your usual name and the name on the identification document separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場ではこの呼び名ですが、証明書はこの表記です。別人の書類ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 呼び名と証明書名が同じ本人だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is what people call me at work, but this is how my name appears on the document. These are not someone else's documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the everyday name and the name on the document refer to the same person, yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認できるよう、ご説明を添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will include that explanation so the person in charge can check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。次の欄も同じ名前が必要か、まとめて伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他欄の表記も一緒に確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I would also like to ask at the same time whether the next field needs the same name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check the name format in the other fields at the same time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 職場での呼び名と証明書の表記を分けて、担当へ引き継ぎます。ほかの氏名欄も確認してからご記入ください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the person in charge, distinguishing your workplace name from the name on your document. Please check the other name fields before filling them in as well. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の確認をいたします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は二つの科に予約があります。いまの受付で両方済みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同日二科の受付が両方成立したか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have appointments with two departments today. Did this check-in register me for both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether check-in has been completed for both departments on the same day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票を二枚拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see both appointment slips?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。先ほどは片方だけ出しました。同じ病院なので一緒だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片方だけ予約票を出した経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Certainly. I only handed in one earlier. I thought they were handled together because it is the same hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how you came to hand in only one appointment slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの受付状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the registration status for each department.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ受け付けていない科があれば、どこへ行くか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未受付科の受付先の案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. If I have not checked in for one department yet, please tell me where to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to check in for a department where you are not yet registered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先に案内された診療科から呼ばれる可能性もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The department you were directed to first might call you as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 移動する前に、その科にも行き先を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動前に先の科にも行き先を伝えたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before moving, I would like to tell that department where I am going too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to tell the first department your destination before moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 順序も担当に確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the order with the person in charge before directing you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの予約時刻が近いことも伝えてください。勝手に順番を変えず待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 近接予約時刻を共有し順序確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please also tell them that the two appointment times are close together. I will wait without changing the order myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share that the appointment times are close together and wait for the order to be confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約時刻が近いことも両方の受付へ確認します。順序が決まるまでは移動せずお待ちください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will also check with both reception desks about the appointment times being close together. Please wait here until the order is decided. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 失くされた物の特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please describe the item you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ポーチです。写真がありますが、隣に他人の書類まで写っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ポーチ写真に他人の書類が写ったと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a pouch. I have a photo, but someone else's documents beside it are also in the picture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that another person's documents appear in the photo of your pouch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 関係する部分だけ見せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you show me only the relevant part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ポーチだけ拡大します。書類の名前は見せる必要がありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ポーチだけ拡大して無関係な氏名を隠す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will zoom in on just the pouch. There is no need to show the names on the documents, is there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Zoom in on just the pouch and hide the unrelated names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ポーチの外観と、失くした場所をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me what the pouch looks like and where you lost it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 灰色で角が擦れています。最後に見たのはバスの中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外観の特徴と最後に見た場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is gray with worn corners. I last saw it on the bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe its appearance and where you last saw it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中の物で、ご自身の物と確認できる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything inside that would help confirm it belongs to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内側に自分の頭文字を縫ってあります。写真には写っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真にない所有確認用の内側の特徴を補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My initials are stitched on the inside. They do not show in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add an identifying feature inside the pouch that is not visible in the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その特徴も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record that feature as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。書類の写った写真を周囲に送らず、ポーチの説明だけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 第三者情報入り写真を拡散せず物の説明だけ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not send the photo containing the documents around; I will only give a description of the pouch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not circulate a photo containing a third party's information; give only a description of the item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 頭文字の特徴も添えて担当へ引き継ぎます。写真を周囲に送らず、届出ではポーチの特徴をお伝えください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the person in charge, including the initials. Please do not send the photo around; describe the pouch when reporting it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 番号札をお持ちのお客様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are holding a queue ticket, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この番号を家族に伝えれば、荷物がどこにあるか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 順番札で荷物の状況を確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: If I give this number to my family, can they find out where my package is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the queue ticket can be used to check the status of your package. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その札は窓口の順番を示す物です。荷物の番号ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: That ticket shows your place in the queue at the counter. It is not a package number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族にはもう送ってしまいました。まだ荷物を渡していないのに、追跡番号だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未発送なのに家族へ追跡番号として伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I already sent it to my family. I thought it was a tracking number even though I had not handed over the package yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you gave your family the number as a tracking number even though the package has not been sent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ発送前です。追跡については発送方法と合わせてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It has not been sent yet. We will explain tracking along with the shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず家族に、窓口の順番札だったと訂正します。荷物を送ったとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 順番札の誤連絡を訂正し発送済みとは言わないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: First I will correct my message to my family and explain that it was a queue ticket for the counter. I will not say the package has been sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the mistaken message about the queue ticket and decide not to say the package has been sent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発送の方法はお決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided how to send it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届いた状況を確認したいです。その目的に合う方法と控えを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着状況確認に合う発送方法と控えを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to check whether it has arrived. I would like advice on a suitable shipping method and receipt for that purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about a shipping method and receipt that allow you to check delivery status. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご利用できる方法と費用を確認してからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose after checking the available methods and their costs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて決めます。正式な控えを受け取ってから、家族へ必要な番号を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式な控え受領後に必要番号を家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will listen to the explanation before deciding. Once I receive the official receipt, I will give my family the number they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your family the necessary number after receiving the official receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 順番札と追跡用の控えを分けたいご希望を、発送担当へ伝えます。利用方法を選んでから正式な控えをお確かめください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the shipping staff that you want to distinguish the queue ticket from the tracking receipt. After choosing a service, please check the official receipt. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から「送った」と連絡が来ましたが、口座にはまだ見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送金連絡と口座未入金を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family told me they had sent the money, but I cannot see it in my account yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a transfer notification and money not yet credited to your account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送金した時刻や、控えは確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check the time the transfer was made or the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連絡の時刻だけ分かります。実際に手続きした時刻はまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡時刻しか知らず送金処理時刻は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only know when they contacted me. I have not yet asked when they actually completed the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only know the notification time and do not know when the transfer was processed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送金の連絡と、ご自身の口座への入金は分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the transfer notification separately from the credit to your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。連絡が来た時刻を、入金時刻だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡受信を入金成立と考えた誤りを認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I had assumed that the time the message arrived was the time the money reached my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge your mistake in treating receipt of the message as confirmation of the deposit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送金元で確認できる情報をご家族にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask your family for the information they can check at the sending bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族には手続き日と送金先を聞きます。私の口座履歴はここで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送金元情報と自分の履歴の照会先を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask my family for the transaction date and destination account. I would like to check my own account history here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish where to inquire about the sender's information and your own transaction history. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人様の確認後、確認できる範囲をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After verifying your identity, we will explain what we can check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。入金を確認するまでは、そのお金を使える前提にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入金確認前に使用可能額に算入しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Until I confirm the money has arrived, I will not assume it is available to spend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to include the money in your available balance before confirming the deposit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 口座履歴の確認は担当へおつなぎします。ご家族への確認とは分けて進め、入金が確認できるまでは予定に組み込まないでください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to the person handling account history checks. Please handle this separately from checking with your family, and do not include the money in your plans until the deposit is confirmed. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱を動かされたのはお客様でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you the person who moved this box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。空箱だと思って置場へ運びましたが、中に商品がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空箱と誤認して商品入り箱を移動したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought it was empty and carried it to the storage area, but there were products inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you mistook a box containing products for an empty box and moved it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ち帰り用の空箱とは別の箱ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it is different from the empty boxes available to take home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すみません。表示を見ずに動かしました。中身には触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示未確認と中身未接触を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am sorry. I moved it without checking the label. I have not touched the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not check the label and have not touched the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を確認しますので、元へ勝手に戻さず教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the location, so please tell us rather than putting it back yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回収の箱と並べてしまいました。どの箱か私が示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 回収箱と混在した位置を示すと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put it alongside the boxes for collection. I will point out which box it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to show where the box was placed among the collection boxes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その場所へご案内いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you take me to that spot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。商品を他の空箱へ移し替えてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現場を案内し商品の移替えもないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is here. I have not transferred the products into any other empty box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the location and explain that you have not moved the products into another box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。私どもで状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will check their condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。次から空箱か商品用か分からなければ、動かす前に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明な箱は動かす前に確認すると約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Next time, if I cannot tell whether a box is empty or used for products, I will ask before moving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to ask before moving a box if you are unsure about it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご申告ありがとうございます。あとは係で確認します。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Our staff will handle the rest of the check. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 長い棒をお使いになる前に、どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you use that long pole, could you tell me what happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 凧が枝に掛かりました。棒で落とそうとしましたが、人が通っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 枝の凧と棒での回収予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A kite got caught in a branch. I was going to knock it down with the pole, but people are walking past.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the kite is in a branch and that you planned to retrieve it with a pole. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に取ろうとせず、その棒はいったん置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not force it down. Put the pole down for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置きます。木に登ることもやめます。どこに掛かったかお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棒を置き木登りもせず位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will put it down. I will not climb the tree either. I will tell you where it is caught.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put down the pole, do not climb the tree, and describe the location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を確認して、対応できるか担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the location and ask the person in charge whether anything can be done.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: すぐ取れるとは限らないですね。子どもにも待つよう説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 即時回収を前提にせず子どもにも待機を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It may not be possible to get it down immediately, then. I will explain to my child that we need to wait too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume immediate retrieval; explain to the child that they need to wait as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 凧のひもが通路に垂れているかは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know whether the kite string is hanging over the path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらから見える範囲では、枝の上にあります。近づいて確かめるのは控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 観察範囲のひもの位置を伝え接近調査を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: As far as I can see from here, it is up on the branches. I will avoid going closer to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the string's position within your field of view and avoid approaching to investigate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見えた範囲の情報で結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The information you can see from there is enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 位置を指して説明します。係の判断が出るまで、自分で取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 係の判断まで自己回収しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will point out the location as I explain. I will not retrieve it myself until the staff have made a decision.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to retrieve it yourself before the staff decide what to do. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見える位置の情報を担当へ伝えます。判断が出るまでは木に登ったり、凧を引いたりしないでください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on the visible location information to the person in charge. Until a decision is made, please do not climb the tree or pull on the kite. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いま車内へ戻ろうとされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you about to go back into the train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物を置き忘れました。でも、ドアが閉まり始めたので戻るのをやめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れ物のため戻ろうとしたが閉扉でやめたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my luggage behind. But the doors started closing, so I stopped trying to go back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you tried to return for a forgotten item but stopped because the doors were closing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に乗り込まないでください。どの車両でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not force your way aboard. Which carriage was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前から二両目だったと思います。正確な番号は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車両の推定位置と番号未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think it was the second carriage from the front. I did not check its exact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the estimated carriage position and that you have not checked its number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で、置いた位置と荷物の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where you left it and what it looks like, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓側の席の足元です。黒い袋に黄色いひもが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 置いた位置と袋の特徴を具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is on the floor by a window seat. It is a black bag with a yellow cord.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe precisely where you left the bag and its distinguishing features. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車と荷物について確認します。ご連絡先も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the train and the luggage. May I have your contact details as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの番号です。次の電車で追いかける前に、駅の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先を出し自己追跡前に案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is my number. Before chasing it on the next train, I will listen to the station's guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide your contact details and request guidance before trying to follow it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた結果をご案内します。ホームの端から離れてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will let you know what we can confirm. Please wait away from the platform edge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、安全なところで待ちます。車両の記憶が曖昧な点も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全な場所で待ち車両情報の不確かさを補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will wait somewhere safe. Please also tell them that my memory of the carriage is unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait in a safe place and add that your carriage information is uncertain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 車両の記憶が曖昧なことも添えて、荷物の確認を依頼します。ご連絡をお待ちの間もホームの端へ近づかないでください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ask them to check the luggage, noting that you are unsure about the carriage. Please stay away from the platform edge while waiting to hear from us. Goodbye.
